title: The Control Room Inside Your Head
intro: This quiz follows Zara and Milo as they discover how the brain controls movement, senses, memories, emotions, and important body functions.

questions.prompt: How does the brain tell the muscles to move?
choices: It sends messages through the spinal cord and nerves
It sends blood directly to the muscles
It fills the muscles with air
It makes the bones move by themselves
questions.explanation: The brain sends messages through the spinal cord and nerves to tell muscles to move.

questions.prompt: What do the senses do before the brain helps us understand something?
choices: They make decisions for the brain
They gather information from around us
They store all our memories
They control the heartbeat
questions.explanation: The senses gather information from around us before the brain helps us understand it.

questions.prompt: Which group lists some jobs performed by different parts of the brain?
choices: Digestion, blood filtering, and bone growth
Thinking, remembering, movement, and balance
Making oxygen, water, and food
Growing hair, nails, and teeth
questions.explanation: Different parts of the brain help with thinking, remembering, movement, and balance.

questions.prompt: What does the brain continue to do while a person is sleeping?
choices: It stops working completely
It controls breathing and heartbeat and helps store memories
It turns off every nerve in the body
It prevents the body from resting
questions.explanation: While sleeping, the brain controls breathing and heartbeat and helps store memories.

questions.prompt: Why is the brain compared to a control room?
choices: It is empty and quiet
It sends messages throughout the body and helps control many body functions
It stores food for the body
It pumps blood to every organ
questions.explanation: The brain is like a control room because it sends messages throughout the body and helps control many body functions.
